description: Farm-track level crossings of the line that no open dataset maps (OpenStreetMap has no way across the line at any of them). Evidence-only points: a chainage and a side, nothing else. No track geometry is drawn from them or invented for them; a rendering step may place a conservative generic crossing (a short gap in any fence, the trail's own surface across, no gates or track beyond the trail's corridor) at `km`, or leave it out.
source: Gwynedd Council map capture, position only, Crown copyright — evidence, not reproduced
licence: The captures show an OS MasterMap base (© Crown copyright and database rights 2026, OS licence AC0000821460 held by the council). They are not reproduced, traced or digitised: only the existence of each crossing and its approximate chainage are recorded here, read against the project's own open data (OpenStreetMap, OS OpenMap - Local, the trackbed line).
chainage: km along data/railway-route.geojson (13.24 km), as the registers use. The reviews measured with an equirectangular projection; `reportedKm` is their figure and `km` the register chainage (the north and middle reviews' figures times about 1.003; the south review's were already scaled). Each is good to about `uncertaintyM`.
sides: Left and right as travelled from Blaenau Ffestiniog towards Trawsfynydd.
